service.description: The load scripts of the loaded components, the test/load/*.load.js files (D2, D12), by component and name. Each has location (component://name/test/load/File.load.js), componentName, name (File) and fileName.

Start a load script on threads of this server and answer its runId; the run goes on after this returns. Refuses a location that is not a load script of a loaded component, a target that is not allowed (this server, loopback, a prefix in load_runner_targets, or any URL on a dev instance; plain http to another machine only when load_runner_targets names it), more runs at once than load_runner_max_runs (1) and more users than load_runner_max_users (1,000), and a scenario users that is not a whole number of at least 1. targetKind is service (this server's services, called in process; a plan whose uses has service needs it), this (this server over HTTP, by its own URL; the default) or url (another server, targetUrl). parameters fill the plan's parameters; a secret one is held in memory for the run only. scenarios overrides each scenario's settings by name. insecure accepts an invalid certificate and is shown on the run.

Stop a running load: after each user's current iteration, or with now before each user's next request. Its result is written as stopped. A run that is not running on this server is refused with that reason (another node, or already finished).

For the run page's poll: a running load's snapshot from memory, or a finished run's summary. running says which; status is running, completed, stopped or failed. A runId that is neither is refused as not on this server.

The running loads and then the finished runs, newest first. Each is a summary: runId, script, label, user, status, target, start, end, users, iterations, requests, errors, errorRate, rps, p95 and passed. scriptLocation and status narrow the list. A result file that does not read is logged and left out.
A finished run's whole result (plans/LoadRunner.md §5), as its result.json has it.
Delete a finished run's directory. A running load is refused; stop it first.

Keep a result from another machine (moqui test-load's result file) as a run of its own, in a new directory, with label when given. Its run.user is the importer, with the file's kept as run.importedUser; its script and target are only shown, and Run again resolves and checks them anew. A text that is not a load result, or over 16 MiB, is refused.

parameter.name: result
parameter.description: The result, as a Map or as the JSON text of one.

service.description: Two to four finished runs side by side: each run's summary, and per request name each run's count, errors and latency percentiles with the percent change from the first run.
